decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk fits the shift toward flexible workplaces after the pandemic, so its value is still uncertain, keeping it costs little within a configurable system, and the option is worth holding open.
A chair family can be extended across residential and contract segments, and with no negative evidence the low carrying cost justifies keeping the option alive.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with limited demonstrated value, but they reuse rug materials at little extra cost, so they are kept for now while their weaker prospects are watched.
The designer sofa by EOOS got its own page in 2019, a sign of growing commitment, and upholstered seating is core premium business, so the evidence supports keeping it.
The high standing table supports flexible office and conference settings and is cheap to keep in the range, so it stays while uncertainty about its value resolves.

The rug collection is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction and was featured on its own page both years, so the firm has committed to it strategically rather than holding it as a speculative option.
